question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blanks and make the sentence meaningful.

She hurt her ________ and _______.
solution:
The correct answer is "**heel; toe**".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The sentence suggests that the person injured both parts of her foot.**
 
• "Heel" refers to the back part of the foot.(एड़ी)
 
• "Toe" refers to the front part.(पैर की अंगुली)
 
• The correct combination of words is "heel; toe", as it makes sense in the context of the sentence.
 
• Thus, the correct sentence is:
 
 
• She hurt her heel__ and __toe__.
 
 

Hence, **the correct answer is option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• "Heal" means to recover from an injury.(ठीक होना)
 
• "Tow" means to pull something behind a vehicle.(खींचते ले जाना)
